title: Can AI Copy Your Photos? What You Can Actually Protect
description:
Can AI reproduce a photo you posted online? We separate training, image reproduction and permission, then explain what Content Credentials can actually tell you.

The beach pictures and similar output are original illustrative animations, not model test results. No claim is made that your own image was used in training. EU platform controls and US copyright analysis are identified by jurisdiction.

instagramCaption:
Your photo. An AI output. But was it trained on your image, did it reproduce it, and was that use permitted? Those are different questions.

Save this before uploading valuable work: check visibility and training controls, read licence terms, and keep the original. Content Credentials record provenance; they do not block copying.

Original illustrative animation, synthetic narration. Not a hands-on model test.
